newsitem.title: USA: Calif. twins get in car accident - with each other.
newsitem.headline: Calif. twins get in car accident - with each other.

text.p: Identical twins showing off their new cars collided, sending one brother hurtling into a house, police said on Friday.
Brothers Geoffrey and Kristopher Putt, 18, smashed into each other on Wednesday night in Alameda, a city across the bay from San Francisco.
Police said they were trying out their new cars when one brother ran through a stop sign and smashed into his twin's car, sending it spinning into a house.
Neither Putt was hurt in the accident, but the cars, both Nissans, were badly damaged.
"It was strange," said Police Lt. Craig Ojala. "We have a lot of people crashing into each other on a regular basis, but not two members of the same family, let alone twins."
